description: This file defines a Configuration object that provides methods to retrieve various application configuration values such as API URLs, service URLs, context path, logo URL, and Keycloak configuration. It exports this configuration as the default module export.

methods.name: getDefaultApiUrl
methods.description: Returns the default API URL from the environment variables.

methods.name: getNotificationsServiceUrl
methods.description: Returns the notifications service URL from the environment variables.

methods.name: getContextPath
methods.description: Returns the context path from environment variables or defaults to '/'.

methods.name: getLogoUrl
methods.description: Returns the logo URL from environment variables or defaults to '/logo-name.png'.

methods.name: getKeycloakConfig
methods.description: Returns the Keycloak configuration object, defaults if not specified in environment variables.
